name: openai-codex-hackathon
description: Prototype Codex-native hackathon experience for rules, resources, progress tracking, and submission prep before final Devpost handoff.

interface.longDescription: Prototype plugin for replacing most of the participant-side Devpost journey with a richer Codex experience: orientation, rules review, resources, live progress tracking, submission drafting, and final preflight before browser handoff. It intentionally stops short of direct Devpost submission while sponsor, legal, and event copy are still being finalized.
defaultPrompt: Start my OpenAI Codex Hackathon flow in this folder.
Show my hackathon map and next step.
Show the next deadline and what I should do before submitting.
